Space Tank Gaming in Malad is a well planned and thoughtfully designed gaming venue that makes efficient use of its available space across multiple floors. While PC gaming is currently not available which would have been a welcome addition the overall experience remains enjoyable and well managed.
The basement level houses PlayStation 5 setups along with a Indoor Cricket Simulator, offering an engaging experience for console and sports gaming enthusiasts. The first floor functions as a cafeteria, providing a comfortable space to relax between sessions. The second floor is dedicated to arcade games, which are well maintained and add a fun, nostalgic element to the venue.
The arcade section, in particular, stands out for its variety and upkeep. The presence of two massage chairs is a thoughtful touch.
Additionally, the availability of a lift is convenient, especially considering the multiple floors, even though it operates at a slightly slower pace.
Overall, Space Tank Gaming is a neatly organized and enjoyable gaming destination. With good use of space.

I did not try the food during my visit, so I cannot comment on that aspect.

We politely asked for either a refund or at least some game compensation since we had already spent so many points on that game and clearly know how to use it. But instead of helping, the technician arrogantly replied, “Who told you to play this game?” and “Don’t play this game.”

Seriously? Then why keep the game active if customers are not supposed to play it?

We even purchased a Gold Card worth ₹10,000 from the reception, expecting premium service, but instead got rude behavior and zero accountability. Rather than solving the issue, your staff questioned us for playing the game itself. Absolutely unbelievable.

I have visited many Timezone venues like Oberoi, Inorbit, R-City, Capital Mall, Growel’s, etc., and never experienced such pathetic customer service anywhere else. This branch has completely ruined the experience for me and my nephew.

The Venue Head, Prabhat, seriously needs to look into the behavior and attitude of the staff here. Customers are spending money to enjoy, not to get insulted for using the games available at the venue.

Truly disappointing. Negative rating from my side.
